newsitem.title: USA: Intel rally heats up Nasdaq Composite.
newsitem.headline: Intel rally heats up Nasdaq Composite.

text.p: Intel Corp said Tuesday its third quarter revenues would come in better than forecast, setting alight the high tech sector and pushing the Nasdaq Composite to its highest close since June.
The Nasdaq Composite Index was up 9.35 points, or 0.78 percent, at 1203.31 at its unofficial close but losers inched ahead of gainers by 2098 to 2002 on volume of about 644 million shares.
It was Nasdaq's highest close since June 17, when the Index closed at 1207.64. It reached a record closing high of 1249.15 on June 5.
"The move in Intel is spectacular. The strength in the high tech blue chips should spill over into secondary names," said Ralph Bloch, chief technical analyst at Raymond James.
Intel topped Nasdaq's most active list, rising 5-5/8 to 94-1/4. The announcement prompted several brokerages to raise their ratings or EPS forecasts.

Right behind Intel on the actives list came Atmel Corp, up 4-1/8 at 28-1/4 and Applied Materials Inc, up 1-5/8 at 27-3/8. General Scanning fell 3-1/2 to 10 after Hambrecht & Quist cut the stock to buy from strong buy and lowered its third and fourth quarter EPS view.
